mechanism: Validations are secp256k1-only; a validation carries sfSigningPubKey + sfSignature and is verified by verifyDigest
attacker_capability_needed: Forge secp256k1 signatures for k validator keys
verdict: One broken key = one forged vote; 45 needed to force a majority at full participation

mechanism: Manifest binds an ephemeral signing key to a master key with two signatures; sequence 0xFFFFFFFF revokes the master key
attacker_capability_needed: Forge a manifest under a broken master key
measured_support: Probed node manifest ephemeral==master (n9K4Aom); VHS: all 66 validators use a distinct ephemeral signing key
verdict: One broken master key lets the attacker rotate or revoke that validator; buys no amendment vote by itself

mechanism: doValidation returns supported non-vetoed amendments as the node's desired list; veto is persisted in wallet.db
attacker_capability_needed: Break keys (to change votes) or gain node admin (to veto)
measured_support: fixAmendmentMajorityCalc enabled; PF amendments not enabled; 0 majorities live
verdict: Veto is local and admin-only; it changes one node's vote not the network tally

mechanism: sfAmendments (enabled set) and sfMajorities (majority timestamps) live in the ledger's amendment entry; the ledger is the authority
attacker_capability_needed: Forge a validated ledger (needs consensus) or forge a majority via votes
measured_support: 64 enabled amendments; all enabled at ledger 86785 on 2026-02-09T14:31:12Z; 0 majorities
verdict: The ledger record cannot be forged by votes alone; a majority must be recorded first

mechanism: An amendment enables only after holding a majority for defaultAmendmentMajorityTime (2 weeks); doVoting emits the no-flag pseudo-transaction only when majorityTime + 2 weeks <= closeTime
attacker_capability_needed: Break the ledger clock or forge the majority timestamp (needs consensus)
measured_support: No amendment currently holds a majority; no majority timestamp exists live
verdict: The hold cannot be shortcut by votes: it is enforced by code against the ledger-recorded majority time

mechanism: Admin-only RPC `feature` with vetoed:true sets a persistent local veto; a vetoed amendment is never in the node's desired list
attacker_capability_needed: Gain admin access to a node's RPC (out of scope for the quantum adversary)
measured_support: Public feature call returns no veto state (admin-only fields)
verdict: Not remotely reachable by forging signatures; local only

mechanism: Only validations from trusted validators are counted; doVoting runs only when trusted validations reach the node's quorum (max(ceil(UNL*0.67) ceil(UNL*0.6)))
attacker_capability_needed: Break k keys inside the victim node's trust set
measured_support: 66 validators; 25 in UNL; probed node validation_quorum 17 (= ceil(25*0.67)); last_close proposers 24
verdict: A node's majority is computed over its own trust set; the network-wide threshold uses the full trusted set
